register.labelZh: SQUARE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: 當所有安排、款項或尚未解決的問題都必須在某事開始前處理好時,可以使用 square somethingaway。；square off 表示對手在比賽或辯論中較量;square up to somebody 則表示某人以帶有威嚇性的姿態面對另一人。；square with something 可以用來說明某個說法、數字、承諾或日期是否與其他資料一致。；square something with somebody 可以直接表示某項計劃或改動需要先取得另一人的同意。
register.summaryEn: Square something away is useful when all the arrangements, payments or remaining problems must be dealt with before something can begin. Square off describes opponents meeting in a competition or debate. Square up to somebody describes a person facing someone in a threatening way. Square with something helps you explain whether a story, number, promise or date agrees with other information. Square something with somebody is a direct way to say that a plan or change needs another person’s permission.
